_help: Hand-curated outside events. Add one object per event. Times are local Eastern. Use "allDay": true and a date-only "start" (YYYY-MM-DD) for all-day events. category: area | benefits | community | post. Always include the organizer's page in "url" so members can confirm details.

events.title: McBride's 12th Annual 0K Road Race
events.location: McBride's Pub, 161 Wayland Ave, Providence, RI
events.description: Tongue-in-cheek "0K" fun run/walk starting at noon in Wayland Square to benefit Operation Stand Down RI's veteran housing and support programs. $50 includes shirt, two beverage tickets, and one lunch ticket.

events.title: Veterans Resource Fair & BBQ (Congressman Gabe Amo)
events.location: Pete Sepe Pavilion, 40 Asylum Rd, Warren, RI
events.description: Free veterans resource fair and BBQ hosted by Congressman Gabe Amo and the RI Office of Veterans Services. Free food and drinks, veterans services on-site; veterans and military families welcome. RSVP: (401) 729-5600 or Olivia.Teixeira@mail.house.gov.
events.source: RI Office of Veterans Services / Office of Rep. Gabe Amo

events.title: Rocky Point Park Walk (Weekend Warriors of New England)
events.description: Evening group walk for veterans hosted by Weekend Warriors of New England, listed on RI Office of Veterans Services' events calendar.

events.title: Veterans Golf 2026
events.location: Button Hole, 1 Button Hole Dr, Providence, RI
events.description: Veterans golf outing at the Button Hole adaptive golf facility. Contact dwright@buttonhole.org for details.

events.title: Patrick Lenihan Car Show (VFW Post 449)
events.location: VFW Post 449, 197 Providence Street, West Warwick, RI
events.description: Annual car show hosted by VFW Post 449, open to the public with cars new and old on display.

events.title: New Veteran Orientation: Learn, Explore and Thrive
events.location: VA Providence Medical Center, Main Building 5th Floor Classrooms, 830 Chalkstone Ave, Providence
events.description: Enrollment & claims support (noon-1pm) followed by New Veteran Orientation (1-3pm): learn about VA services, accommodations, and claims assistance. Free, registration required. Contact Cheryl.Richard@va.gov.

events.title: OktoberVets 5K (VFW Post 152)
events.location: Start: First Baptist Church, 44 Main St, North Kingstown; Finish: Town Docks, 61 Brown St, North Kingstown
events.description: 5K race through historic Wickford Village hosted by VFW Post 152, plus a .152K fun run for all ages, with a 11:00am start wave. Proceeds benefit the Gateway to Independence veteran transitional housing program and the Holiday Veteran in Need program.

events.title: VA Providence Employment Resource Center Veteran Job Fair
events.location: Providence VA Medical Center, Main Building 5th Floor Classrooms, 830 Chalkstone Ave, Providence
events.description: Free job fair connecting veterans with local employers. Contact the Employment Resource Center at 401-273-7100 ext. 13491.

events.title: VA Providence Fall VetConnect
events.location: VA Providence Healthcare System, 830 Chalkstone Avenue, Providence, RI
events.description: Veterans and families join VA Providence leadership for updates on programs and to connect with representatives from VA Enrollment and the Veterans Benefits Administration.

events.title: Westerly Veterans Day Parade
events.location: Westerly, RI (organized by the Ocean Community Chamber of Commerce)
events.description: Check the organizer's page for the route and step-off point.

events.title: WaterFire Salute to Veterans (14th annual)
events.location: State House to WaterPlace Park, Providence
events.description: Opening ceremonies at the State House, torch procession, Veterans Resource Fair on Washington Street (3:00-10:00 p.m.), military vehicle display, memorial tributes at sunset and a Memorial Canoe Ceremony. About 150 veterans serve as torchbearers; sign-up and mobility assistance are on the event page.

events.title: Cranston Veterans Day Parade
events.location: Starts on Doric Avenue behind the Pub on Park, along Park Avenue to Pontiac Avenue, north on Rolfe Street to Rolfe Square, followed by a ceremony at the Cannon Memorial, Cranston
events.description: Annual Veterans Day parade and ceremony revived as a Cranston tradition. Time/route based on the 2025 running; check the city's page closer to the date for any changes.

events.title: VFW Post 449 Turkey Trot
events.location: VFW Post 449, 197 Providence Street, West Warwick, RI
events.description: Community Turkey Trot event hosted by VFW Post 449.
